title: Annotatio IV §.XIV: Wulfinus Homily — host Christ’s body not CORPORALITER but SPIRITUALITER
pass_a_gloss: But another Homily of Bishop Wulfinus informs thus concisely indeed, yet very nervously: That Host (namely the Sacramental) is Christ’s body, not CORPORALLY but SPIRITUALLY — not the body in which Christ suffered, but the body of which He spoke when He consecrated bread and wine into the host.
pass_b_english: Bishop Wulfinus’s Homily, brief but sinewy: the sacramental Host is Christ’s body not CORPORALLY but SPIRITUALLY.
Not the body in which Christ suffered, but the body of which He spoke when He consecrated bread and wine into the host.
source_text: Altera verò Wulfini Episcopi Homilia, concisè equidem, at nervosè admodum sic informat: Hostia illa (scil. Sacramentalis) est Christi corpus, non CORPORALITER, sed SPIRITUALITER, non corpus in quo passus est Christus, sed corpus de quo locutus est, quando panem & vinum in hostiam consecravit.

lemmas.latin: non corpus in quo passus est
lemmas.gloss: not the body in which He suffered
